messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered for customer CeresCorp (enterprise). Incident INC-2026-0427. Affected: eu-west-1 dedicated pool (vpc: vpce-ceres-01). Symptoms: increased 5xx tail, session steal, KV cache thrash. Paging: Jordan (oncall).

Jordan (oncall): I'm on it. Joining bridge now. Can someone drop a quick summary of impact? @Rajesh (CeresCorp) can you confirm customer-visible issues?

Rajesh (CeresCorp): Morning — hitting ~30% 502s on generation endpoints for eu-west-1. Timeout errors for some tenants, user sessions failing. We started routing retries but seeing latency spikes.

Priya (SRE): Thanks. Observed high queue depth on the eu-west-1 dedicated pool hosts, and repeated OOMs on the LLM runtime for the Ceres tenant container group. Looks like one of the warm nodes degraded and caused request redistribution. Alert graph: cpu+mem spike at 06:12 UTC.

Ops-Eng: We're seeing KV cache miss storm for tenant ceres-01; hit-rate dropped from 98%->12% after node flip. That caused repeated long recalc of prefix caches.

NetEng: No obvious network E/W issues. Load balancer health checks flapping for the dedicated pool; host level SIGKILLs observed in dmesg on two machines.

Jordan (oncall): Current hypothesis: host instability in dedicated pool evicted runtime workers which forced clients to cold-start and rehydrate caches; combined with low warm capacity we hit congestion. Plan: shift CeresCorp traffic to their warm fallback pool in eu-west-2, then repair eu-west-1 nodes. Need approvals and a short maintenance window (5-10m for cutover).

Rajesh (CeresCorp): We approve. We prefer minimal TTL change approach. Keep us posted on canary.

Priya (SRE): Action list:
1) Create canary route to warm pool (1% traffic) for 10m
2) Monitor error rates + latency
3) If stable, do bulk DNS swap with lower TTL or BGP shift
4) Post-cutover validate KV hit-rate and success rate
5) Roll back if errors >1% for 5m

Jordan (oncall): I'll start the canary. @deploy-bot queue ready? Also set feature flag to throttle non-critical background requests for ceres-01.


deploy-bot: Canary deployment request received. Creating route rule: redirect 1% of ceres-01 traffic to eu-west-2:warm-pool. ETA 90s.

monitoring-bot: Canary metrics stream: 1% traffic -> errors 0.4%, p95 latency +60ms. Baseline errors were 30% before. Sending dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dash/incidents/INC-2026-0427

Priya (SRE): Canary looking good. Increase to 10% in 5m. Also ops-eng, start warming two extra nodes in eu-west-1 (hot-swap) to restore capacity.

Ops-Eng: Kicking off warm nodes: provisioning g4dnx2a equivalents, applying runtime image v2.9.1 with kv-cache priming. Using following command to pre-warm:
```
redwoodctl node add --region eu-west-1 --pool ceres-dedicated --count 2 --image runtime:v2.9.1 --prewarm=true
```
Prewarm will load top-50 prompts cache for tenant ceres-01.

NetEng: DNS plan — current Route53 TTL is 300s. We can do weighted DNS change to shift 90% to eu-west-2 and 10% stay eu-west-1 for validation, then swap. Alternate is prefix routing via our smart-router. Which preferred?

Jordan (oncall): Use weighted DNS to avoid broad immediate change. Steps:
- Step A: 10% -> eu-west-2 (5m stable)
- Step B: 50% -> eu-west-2 (5m)
- Step C: 100% -> eu-west-2

Priya (SRE): Remember to pause autoscaler on eu-west-2 warm pool to avoid unexpected scale. Also throttle cache-prime to avoid thundering herd.

Ops-Eng: eu-west-1 warm nodes are up and prewarm progress at 70%. But underlying host kernel logs show an AVC SELinux denial pattern? Might be an image regression. We'll keep them quarantined until verified.

Jordan (oncall): OK proceeding with DNS weighted shift. NetEng, please apply weight change with TTL 60s for faster rollbacks. Use change-batch file with Route53.

NetEng: Applying change now. Change-batch snippet (applied):
```
{
  "Comment": "Weighted shift for CeresCorp - inc INC-2026-0427",
  "Changes": [
    {"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{
      "Name":"api.cerescorp.example.internal.","Type":"A",
      "SetIdentifier":"eu-west-2-warm","Weight":10,"TTL":60,
      "ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"10.2.3.44"}]
    }},
    {"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{
      "Name":"api.cerescorp.example.internal.","Type":"A",
      "SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1-primary","Weight":90,"TTL":60,
      "ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"10.1.9.81"}]
    }}
  ]
}
```
Change submitted: changeId Z3ABCDEF. Rolling out.

monitoring-bot: Weighted 10% -> eu-west-2 metrics: errors on eu-west-1 drop to 12%, eu-west-2 errors 0.5%. Overall errors ~9% down from 30%.

Rajesh (CeresCorp): Seeing successful connections on eu-west-2. A few sessions still hitting old hosts but mostly green.

Priya (SRE): Increase weight to 50% now.

NetEng: Updated weight to 50/50. ChangeId Z3ABCDEF-2.

monitoring-bot: After 50% shift: eu-west-1 errors 6%, eu-west-2 0.6%, total errors ~3.5%. p95 latency trending down.

Jordan (oncall): Continue to 100% if stable for 10m. Meanwhile Ops-Eng, file for root cause on the host image regression and mark the two nodes as quarantined.

Ops-Eng: Created internal ticket #SRE-INC-1812 to track image regression, kernel OOMs. We'll repro locally with the image.

Liam (next-oncall): Taking notes for handoff at 08:00 UTC. If you need me to take over mid-cutover, ping. I'll review the change history and rollback steps.

Jordan (oncall): Proceeding to 100% in 5m.

NetEng: Updated weight to 100% eu-west-2. ChangeId Z3ABCDEF-3. TTL remains 60s.

monitoring-bot: Post swap metrics: overall errors <0.5%, p95 latency back to baseline. KV cache hit-rate on warm pool stabilizing at 93%.

Rajesh (CeresCorp): Confirming production flow normal. Thanks team, major client impact resolved from customer side. Will keep ticket open until you confirm eu-west-1 remediation.

Priya (SRE): Good job. Next steps: (a) Rollback plan documented (dns weight revert + set TTL back) (b) Investigate image regression + add preflight to runtime deploys (c) Run postmortem with customer-visible timeline.

Jordan (oncall): Handoff to Liam in 30m. I'll leave runbook notes in the incident channel. Key artifacts: changeId Z3ABCDEF-3, prewarm logs at /var/log/prewarm/ceres-01.log, SRE-INC-1812.

Liam (next-oncall): Got it. Taking over monitoring and customer comms at 08:00 UTC. If anything spikes >1% errors, I'll revert weights to last known good.

Ops-Eng: eu-west-1 nodes quarantined and images rolled back to runtime:v2.9.0 for further validation. Keeping pool drained until RCA complete.

Jordan (oncall): Closing pager for now. Incident set to status: mitigated. Will reopen if regression observed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 status changed to MITIGATED by Jordan (oncall). Postmortem owner: Priya (SRE).
